The PubMed count was **12,405** with the Entrez-date cutoff of 2020-07-20. The systematic-review block returned 289,919 records; the environmental-health block returned 1,258,854. The full audit lists every numbered term and its count.

## Validation and limitations

I screened in two records found during PubMed pilot searches. The strategy retrieved both: **2/2 (100% relative recall against this development set)**. This is not independent validation or a sensitivity estimate; no held-out set or prior-review benchmark was established.

The optional methodological-rigour block reduced the count by 24.2%. I left it out to preserve recall and screened its 30-record loss sample; none met the eligibility criteria. The resulting count exceeds the standard 10,000-record workload budget. The broad `environment*` term contributes to that screening burden.

The scope assumptions remain unconfirmed, as requested. The internal critic was same-context; **PRESS peer review by an information specialist is still needed before use**.
